margins.in_native_rule: Net, paired: inside the native window A1 FAILS iff a one-sided exact McNemar test on the paired discordant items (A0 right / A1 wrong = b, versus A0 wrong / A1 right = c) is significant at alpha = 0.05, i.e. P(X >= b | n = b + c, p = 0.5) <= 0.05; otherwise NOT-FAIL. The point estimate (mean paired score difference, b, c) is always reported beside the verdict.
margins.right_threshold: an item is RIGHT iff its score >= 1.0 (fully correct); partial-credit scores count as wrong
margins.needle_cells_keep: A1 >= A0 - 1 correct of 10 (E1 rule, unchanged)
margins.bins: REAL prompt_n, step 32768; zone from retokenize.label_zone only
